bio:
James Reeve, remembered as Major James Reeve of Mattituck and recorded in the family as Captain James Reeves, was born at Mattituck on Long Island on 14 March 1672 and died there on his sixtieth birthday, 14 March 1732. His daughter Hannah, who died on 8 March 1764 aged sixty-four, married Joshua Tuthill of Cutchogue, born in 1690, the son of John Tuthill Jr. and Mehitable Wells.

Joshua Tuthill was John's 9th-great-granduncle, so James Reeve is an in-law of the family rather than one of John's ancestors.
researchNotes: Akerly ([R4-S1]) records that Joshua Tuthill of Cutchogue (b. 1690, son of John Tuthill Jr & Mehitable Wells) married Hannah, 'da. of Major James Reeve of Mattituck', who died 8 Mar 1764 aged 64. This is the tree's 'Captain James Reeves' (father of Hannah, I282695486799). He is therefore the father-in-law of John's 9th-great-granduncle Joshua Tuthill, an in-law and not an ancestor, consistent with the earlier correction that Hannah married Joshua, not James.
